_about: Every College Scorecard API field lib/ingest/scorecard.ts asks for, and where its name was checked.

source 'dictionary': the developer-friendly name, variable and description from the College Scorecard data dictionary, as packaged in rscorecard 0.21.0 (R/sysdata.rda, github.com/btskinner/rscorecard).

source 'site': not in that edition of the dictionary; the name is the one College Scorecard's own site requests (github.com/RTICWDT/college-scorecard, composables/useConstants.js, dev branch, November 2025), under the constant named.

latest.completion.consumer_rate: the field Scorecard's site sorts and filters schools by graduation rate with (COMPLETION_RATE). The rate the site displays is Outcome Measures (an award within 8 years of entering, all entering students) where reported, else the first-time full-time rate within 150% of normal time; the dictionary edition above predates consumer_rate, so that it is exactly this blend is inferred, not confirmed. It is never a 6-year rate: serve it as Scorecard's graduation rate, and use grad_rate_150 for a timed first-time full-time rate.
Checked 2026-10-15. test/unit/ingest.test.ts fails when a requested field has no entry here: look the new field up and add it.
